name: harness-flow
description: HarnessFlow — a harness that drives AI coding agents from a raw idea to a working app: product-layer shaping (hf-shape/hf-skeleton), main-chain discipline (SDD + TDD) along frame -> plan -> build -> verify -> ship, exploration mode for disposable prototypes, mechanical gates (hf_gate.py init/status/next/run/check), demo-gated acceptance, and pluggable ext-* domain extensions.
